description: Read only. Price a private swap of one note's value from one asset into another on a Gloam network, with everything that would stop it: price impact and peg on Base and Ethereum, the vault's limits (the refund note must fit, the vault must take what you receive), the vault's cash-out fee read live, and where gas is dear the relay's smallest swap. A private swap hides who swapped; the tokens and the amounts are public. Swap with gloam_execute_private_swap.

amount.description: How much to swap, in the asset's units (e.g. 25 for 25 USDC).

from.description: What you pay: a symbol ("USDG", "USDC", "ETH") or a 0x token address. Left out with a note handle: the note's asset.

maxImpactBps.description: The most price impact to accept, in basis points (100 = 1%). It can only lower the owner's cap (GLOAM_SWAP_MAX_IMPACT_BPS, 200 unless set), never raise it.

network.description: Which network to swap on: "robinhood-mainnet", "tempo-mainnet", "base-mainnet", "ethereum-mainnet", "robinhood", "tempo", "base", "ethereum". The -mainnet ones are the mainnets (beta deposit limits); "robinhood", "tempo", "base" and "ethereum" are the testnets. Default here: "robinhood".

note.description: A note handle (gloam_list_notes): quote swapping its whole value.

to.description: What you receive: a symbol or a 0x token address ("ETH" is native ETH).

name: gloam_swap_quote
title: Quote a private swap
